title.en: An Act Appropriating Out of Any Funds in the Insular Treasury Not Otherwise Appropriated the Sum of Seven thousand Five Hundred Pesos for Assistance of Private Schools Estavlished in the Mountain Province.

text.en:
The sum of seven thousand five hundred pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the
Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be allotted by the Secretary of the Interior, for the assistance of
private schools established in the MOuntain Province.

This Act shall take effect upon its passage.
Enacted, February 23, 1916.
